purpose: Make the grammar-blocked verdict mechanical and prevent indefinite run-another-batch search loops.

must_trigger_blocked_verdict_if: no rejection is attributable only to a fixable implementation omission
fixable_implementation_omission_examples: missing field required by the frozen sketch schema before any score is computed
serialization failure that prevents an otherwise declared baseline from running
deterministic parser error unrelated to surface semantics
non_fixable_hard_failure_examples: legal compute enters oracle equivalence band
oracle requires hidden or answer-key access
the only gap comes from an omitted or underpowered baseline

must_trigger_blocked_verdict_if: two consecutive repaired batches produce zero promoted full-harness candidates
each batch completed the required battery and independent static scan
the only proposed way to create a gap is to weaken, omit, alias, underpower, or restrict fair baselines
no proposed sketch can supply oracle_vs_planner_separation_argument
or the argument relies on forbidden access
or the argument relies on answer-key diagnostic oracle
or the argument relies on hidden state
or the argument relies on baseline omission
or the argument relies on metric weakening

cross_batch_search_budget.anti_p_hacking_rule: Do not run additional batches merely because previous batches failed. Continued search must have a route-level rationale that does not weaken, omit, alias, underpower, or restrict fair baselines.

claim_ceiling: Phase-0 environment design-constraint R1 repair only. No headroom confirmation. No Gate1 pass. No mechanism validity. No candidate feasibility. No runtime/mainline effect. No agency/autonomy/consciousness/EGO readiness.
